04FAQ

Questions about websites.

How long does a website take?

It depends on scope. A one-page site is quick, while a multi-page site with forms, integrations or custom animation takes longer. You get a timeline together with the quote, before any work starts.

Do you use templates?

No. I write the design and the code for your project. I use proven frameworks and libraries underneath, but the result is made for you, not reskinned from a theme.

Can you speed up or fix the SEO of my existing site?

Yes. Send me the address and I will check loading speed, page structure, metadata and mobile layout, then tell you what to change and what it would cost.

Will my site rank first on Google?

I build every site so search engines can read it and so it loads quickly. Rankings also depend on your content, competition and time, so nobody honest can promise a position.

Who owns the site and the domain?

You do. I set things up under your accounts, and hand over the code and access at launch unless we agree otherwise.
